name: hifz-tracker-firebase
description: Firebase layer for Hifz Tracker: replaces the Claude Artifact runtime (db, user, downloads) and adds sign-in.

scripts.dev:emulators: node scripts/py.mjs ../build_firebase.py && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,hosting:app --project demo-hifz
scripts.test: npm run test:demo && npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/py.mjs ../build_firebase.py && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,hosting:app --project demo-hifz "node test/e2e.mjs"
